sentences.en: I think it is worthwhile to see this film twice.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这部电影值得再看一遍。

sentences.en: According to the newspaperman, it makes life worthwhile, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 根据这位记者的说法，这能让生活更有意义吧？

sentences.en: The hard work was worthwhile because I passed the exam.
sentences.zh: 因为考试及格了，所以辛苦的努力是值得的。

senses.zh: 值得的, 值得做的, 重要的, 有价值的
